scene: Photorealistic photo of three friends seen from far behind as small silhouettes sitting side by side on a grassy hilltop at sunrise, arms around each other's shoulders, a soft valley below. They sit low in the frame; the upper two-thirds is open, soft, pale golden morning sky.

Photorealistic overhead photo of four pairs of colourful sneakers on green grass, the four pairs pointing inward toward each other in a circle, toes almost touching, soft daylight. The shoes sit in the lower half of the frame; the upper half is plain, softly lit, even green lawn.

Photorealistic close-up photo of five hands stacked together in a team huddle, seen from the side, low in the frame, against a soft, out-of-focus pale blue sky with warm afternoon light. The upper half is that plain, softly blurred sky.

Photorealistic photo of three young women seen from far behind as silhouettes, arms around each other, standing at the edge of the sea at sunset, small in the lower part of the frame, gentle waves. The warm pink and orange sunset sky fills the upper part.

Photorealistic photo of a group of five friends seen as small dark silhouettes jumping in the air together on an open field at sunset, in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is a smooth warm orange and gold sunset sky.

subtitle: എന്നും ഒരുമിച്ച്
scene: Photorealistic photo of a small group of friends seen from behind as silhouettes sitting around a glowing campfire on a hillside in Kerala at dusk, coconut palms on the far hills, the group and fire in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is calm deep blue evening sky, natural colours, not oversaturated.

Photorealistic photo of two vintage bicycles leaning against each other on a quiet country lane lined with flowers at golden hour, low in the frame. The upper half is soft, warm, out-of-focus pale evening sky.

Photorealistic photo of a couple seen from far behind as silhouettes sharing one umbrella, walking down a wet street in gentle rain at blue hour, warm street-light reflections on the road, the couple small in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is soft, plain, misty blue-grey evening air.

Photorealistic photo of two hands, one from each person, joined to form a heart shape held up against a sunset over the sea, the hands in the lower half of the frame with the sun glowing inside the heart. The upper half is a smooth warm orange and pink sky.

Photorealistic photo of two small lovebirds sitting close together on a flowering branch, low in the frame, soft spring morning light. The upper half is a plain, softly blurred, pale cream and green background.

Photorealistic photo of a single red rose lying on a wooden balcony railing at night, low in the frame, soft warm light from a room behind. The upper half is a calm, plain deep-blue night sky with a few faint stars, not oversaturated.

text:
Good night.
Sleep in God’s care.
scene: Photorealistic photo of a quiet fishing harbour at night, a few small wooden boats resting on still water with soft reflections, dark hills along the bottom third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is calm deep-blue night sky with faint stars, natural colours, not oversaturated.

Photorealistic photo of a traditional Kerala house with a sloping tiled roof at night, a single warm oil lamp glowing on the front veranda, potted plants and a small courtyard, the house in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is calm deep-blue night sky with soft stars, not oversaturated.

text:
He who watches
over you
will not slumber.
subtitle: Psalm 121:3
scene: Photorealistic photo of a calm mountain lake at night with dark mountain silhouettes along the lower third of the frame and their faint reflections in the still water. The upper two-thirds is a calm deep-blue night sky with soft stars, natural colours, not oversaturated.

text:
Those who hope
in the Lord will
renew their strength.
subtitle: Isaiah 40:31
scene: Photorealistic photo of misty mountain ranges at sunrise with a single eagle gliding far away over the valley, the mountains and eagle in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is open, soft, pale peach and golden morning sky.

text:
I am the light
of the world.
subtitle: John 8:12
scene: Photorealistic photo of a white lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunrise, calm sea, soft warm sunlight, the lighthouse small in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is open, soft, pale golden and blue morning sky.

text:
Good morning.
Have a blessed day.
scene: Photorealistic photo of a small vase of fresh white and yellow flowers on a sunny wooden window sill in the early morning, low in the frame, soft light. The upper half is a bright, plain, softly blurred cream curtain glowing with morning light.

subtitle: സങ്കീർത്തനങ്ങൾ 118:24
scene: Photorealistic photo of green Kerala paddy fields at sunrise with a narrow path and a few coconut palms on the horizon, gentle morning mist, the fields and palms in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is open, soft, pale golden morning sky.

Photorealistic photo of a chocolate birthday cake with two lit sparklers on a table in a softly lit room, low in the frame, warm bokeh lights. The upper half is a plain, dark, softly blurred background with gentle warm bokeh.

Photorealistic photo of three wrapped gift boxes with ribbons and a little colourful confetti on a pale table, low in the frame, bright soft daylight. The upper half is a plain, bright, pale pastel pink background.

Photorealistic photo of a bouquet of pink roses and white lilies tied with a ribbon on a table beside a few pastel balloons, low in the frame, soft daylight. The upper half is a plain, softly blurred, pale cream wall.

text:
Many happy returns
of the day.
scene: Photorealistic photo of a row of five frosted cupcakes with sprinkles and one lit candle each on a white table, low in the frame, soft daylight. The upper half is a plain, bright, softly blurred pale mint background.

subtitle: ഒരു നല്ല ദിവസം ആശംസിക്കുന്നു
scene: Photorealistic photo of the green tea estates of Munnar in Kerala at sunrise, rolling hills of tea bushes with soft mist in the valleys, in the lower third of the frame. The upper two-thirds is open, soft, pale golden morning sky.

subtitle: ചിരിയോടെ തുടങ്ങാം
scene: Photorealistic close-up photo of fresh white jasmine flowers with morning dew drops on green leaves, low in the frame, soft morning light. The upper half is a plain, softly blurred, pale green and cream background.
